perspectives.name: Side-View
perspectives.description: Classic 2D side-scrolling profile for platformers, beat 'em ups, and metroidvanias.
perspectives.prompt_prefix: side view 2D game asset, horizontal profile perspective, platformer game style, flat ground level
perspectives.negative_prompt: top-down, bird's eye view, isometric angle, high angle shot, perspective tilt, 3D render angle

perspectives.name: Top-Down
perspectives.description: Orthogonal bird's-eye view (90° or slight 75-80° pitch) for classic 2D RPGs, RTS, and action-adventures.
perspectives.prompt_prefix: top-down view game sprite, orthogonal top-down perspective, birds eye view RPG asset, seen from above
perspectives.negative_prompt: side view, horizontal eye level, extreme perspective, horizon line, worm's eye view, ceiling

perspectives.name: Isometric
perspectives.description: 2.5D isometric view (30°/45° angle, true 2:1 dimetric projection) for tactical RPGs and city builders.
perspectives.prompt_prefix: isometric 2.5D game asset, dimetric projection 30 degree angle, sharp isometric grid alignment, clean diagonal edges
perspectives.negative_prompt: straight side view, flat top-down, fisheye perspective, distorted horizon, wide angle lens

perspectives.name: Portrait / Dialog
perspectives.description: Close-up bust or half-body portrait for dialogue boxes, menu status screens, and jRPG cutscenes.
perspectives.prompt_prefix: solo, single character, centered bust shot, head and shoulders portrait, jRPG dialogue avatar, high quality face and shoulders, expressive eyes and hair, centered composition, clean solid background
perspectives.negative_prompt: multiple characters, multiple views, character sheet, expressions sheet, portrait sheet, collage, montage, side by side, extra heads, duplicate heads, cloned face, border avatars, icons, split view, multi-panel, full body, feet, shoes, legs, tiny sprite, platformer angle, overhead map, blurry face, cropped hair
